text:
The kitchen and bathroom job in our Fez flat is now three weeks late. Rachid Ouazzani, the site foreman, told me on Monday that the second tile delivery will arrive on the 14th, and that he can only restart the plumbing once the old pipes in the wall have been signed off. We paid his firm 30,000 dirhams in March, and the next 25,000 falls due when the walls are closed.

My husband, Hicham Lahrichi, had his hours cut at the Meknes warehouse in July, so his pay has been 40 percent lower ever since and will stay that way until at least December. We pay 2,150 dirhams a month on the home improvement loan, and I am not sure we can keep that up unless the bank agrees to a different schedule.

The neighbours upstairs share the pipe stack and want two days' notice before the water is shut off. The foreman's mobile is 06 61 48 20 73, in case the delivery driver needs directions.

text:
Last spring one bank turned down my renovation loan because I had missed two instalments on the car loan during the months my shop was closed. I have since paid everything back, and the credit bureau report was updated in September. My brother Mourad Hadjadj has offered to act as guarantor if another lender asks for one, but I have not yet asked him to sign anything.

For the roof in Constantine I have three quotes. The first, 214,000 dinars, covers 85 square metres of tiles with insulation. The second, 188,000 dinars, covers 85 square metres but without insulation. The third, 161,000 dinars, covers only 70 square metres because that roofer would leave the garage side untouched.

Whichever quote I pick, the work cannot start before the dry season ends in October, and the roofers want 20 percent upfront. My neighbour Wafa Tazi has recommended the second roofer, and her cousin had the same job done last year. The broker can reach me at hakim.merzouk@example.invalid.

text:
Since 3 September the flat above ours in Annaba has had drilling and hammering from about 7:30 most mornings, and on some Saturdays too. The owner, Salima Ouali, told me she is converting the second bedroom into a studio and that the work should end by the middle of November, but she has not given any dates in writing.

I have asked her twice by message to stop before 9:00 on weekdays, and the second time she answered that the building rules allow work from 8:00. The building manager, Farid Sebti, has said he will put a notice on the board if we agree on the hours.

I work nights at the hospital laundry and sleep from about 8 in the morning, and since September I have been getting three or four hours at most. My doctor has written that the broken sleep is making my blood pressure harder to control, and she wants me to bring a note from the building if it continues.

The meeting with the residents' committee is on Thursday evening at 18:30 in the entrance hall. The caretaker's number is 0771 63 05 28 if anyone needs the hall unlocked.

text: Our fence on the south side of the garden in Agadir leans onto the plot of Brahim Ziani, who says it was moved a metre when we rebuilt it in June, though the survey from 2019 shows it is on the line within a few centimetres. Last winter I lent him 12,000 dirhams towards his roof, and he promised to pay it back in four equal parts, of which he has paid only the first. The municipal technician is coming on 28 November to mark the boundary, and Brahim has agreed to accept whatever the stakes show. The fence panels cost 3,800 dirhams, which I am happy to split if the line moves, but not if it does not. His sister Zineb Skalli, who lives in the other half of the house, called me yesterday to say the family wants to settle everything before the new year.

approved_output: Notes, supplier review, Tuesday. Present: [PERSON_1] (procurement), [PERSON_2] (quality), [PERSON_3] (finance). The packaging supplier [ORG] missed two deliveries in October and blamed a resin shortage. [PERSON_2] wants a formal warning, while [PERSON_3] prefers to wait until the November batch arrives. Their last offer was [FINANCIAL] for 200,000 units, valid until 30 November. [PERSON_1] will ask for a penalty clause before anything is signed. [PERSON_2] will be on leave from 1 December, so quality sign-off moves to her deputy. Supplier contact for follow-up: [EMAIL].
